title: Lenox Disney Holiday Cookies for Santa Plate

comparisons.notes: Lenox Disney Holiday Cookies for Santa Plate, sale price $27.57 (was $45.95), add to cart available

writeup: Lenox's porcelain Disney Holiday Cookies for Santa plate features Mickey and Minnie bundled up for Christmas, measures 9.75 inches across, and is dishwasher and microwave safe. Woot has it for $14.99, while Lenox Studio's sale price is $27.57 and Lenox's own site lists it at $45.95 and out of stock.
